data.title: Princess Nourah University Center Advances Behavioral and Psychological Safety in Higher Education
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Behavioral and Psychological Safety Research Center at Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University is working to develop a scientific and advisory framework focused on studying related issues and challenges at higher education institutions in the Kingdom.
    It does so through specialized research and studies, scientific consultations, and evidence-based recommendations, contributing to enhanced behavioral and psychological safety and improved quality of life in the university environment.
    The center specializes in conducting scientific research and studies, developing training programs and strengthening capacities, providing consultations and solutions, establishing databases and indicators, and building local and international partnerships.
    As part of its efforts to support the university environment, the center contributes by developing early detection tools and preventive solutions, training specialists, and providing scientific recommendations to decision-makers. This includes helping universities create safe educational environments that promote behavioral and psychological well-being.
    -- SPA
